column3: “pay no attention to them” renders “hide yourself from them.”
“You are not allowed to neglect them” renders “You will not be able to hide yourself.”
“pay no attention to them” renders “hide yourself from them.”
NASB adds “of seed”; “become defiled” renders “become holy (forfeited).”
“charges her with shameful deeds” renders “makes deeds of words against her”; “publicly defames her” renders “brings out a bad name on her.”
“girl” renders “young woman” (also in verses 16–29); “evidence of the girl’s virginity” renders “the virginity of the young woman.”
“charged her with shameful deeds” renders “made deeds of words”; NASB supplies “evidence.”
“stone her to death” renders “stone her with stones, and she shall die”; “playing the harlot” renders “acting as a prostitute.”
“a married woman” renders “a woman married to a husband.”
“in the field” renders “in the open country”; “forces her” renders “takes hold of her.”
“no one to save her” renders “no deliverer.”
MT 23:1. “so that he shall not” renders “and not”; “skirt” renders the Hebrew closely.
